summary.text: Floyd Prozanski is a state senator from Oregon Senate District 4 who has served since 2003 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, having advanced from both the Democratic and Republican primaries.
He is an attorney who previously served in the Oregon House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: Floyd Prozanski earned a B.S. from Texas A&M University in 1977 and a J.D. from South Texas College of Law in 1983.
His professional experience includes working as an attorney, municipal prosecutor, legal assistant and assistant district attorney.
Prozanski served in the Oregon House of Representatives from 1995 to 2001 and again in 2002 and 2003, before taking office in the Oregon State Senate in 2003.

In the 2023-2024 session, he chaired the Judiciary and Ballot Measure 110 Implementation Committee and was vice chair of the Senate Conduct Committee, and he also served on the Human Services, Mental Health and Recovery Committee and the Natural Resources and Wildlife Recovery Committee.
